header.name: PatrixWorld-Tectonic BP [MS-CANONICAL v0.6.1 VV-CAP]
header.description: v0.6.0 MS-CANONICAL — water files rewritten verbatim from Microsoft's canonical example JSON (learn.microsoft.com/.../watercustomization). Previous v0.5 per-biome wave tuning triggered '[Lighting][error] input outside range [1, 10]' on two of the three files despite all values being documented as in-range. Rather than guess which field's validation is stricter than docs claim, reverting to MS' tested example. Only biome_water_color_contribution differs per biome: alpine 0.6, cherry 0.8, desert 0.9. All other water parameters identical across biomes (chlorophyll:0.5, suspended_sediment:0.5, cdom:1, octaves:28, depth:1, etc.). Cosmetic per-biome diversity now comes from client_biome surface_color + sky_color + grass/foliage tints (which already loaded fine). Biome files unchanged from v0.5.
